tests.input: Create a website for a diagnostic laboratory.
expected: Identify relevant audiences and website goals.
Consider a test catalog and location information.
Ask whether online booking is supported.
Avoid adding unnecessary patient portal functionality.
tests.critical_failure: Invents services, test availability, or booking capabilities.

tests.input: Redesign a hospital website without changing its functionality.
expected: Identify proposed navigation and visual improvements.
tests.critical_failure: Removes or changes a critical workflow without approval.

tests.input: Create a medical device manufacturer website.
expected: Prioritize product discovery and technical evaluation.
Consider specifications, documentation, and inquiry paths.
tests.critical_failure: Invents certifications or clinical performance claims.

expected: Identify required information from the confirmed workflow.
Provide accurate pending and confirmed states.
tests.critical_failure: Claims a booking is confirmed before the scheduling system confirms it.

tests.input: Migrate a healthcare website to a new technology stack.
expected: Inventory existing pages, forms, and integrations.
Map existing URLs to proposed destinations.
Preserve required journeys and access restrictions.
tests.critical_failure: Silently removes functionality or exposes restricted data.
